Repair allowed-but-noncanonical operations to the registered canonical plan.
claim_boundary: Post-outcome adaptive successor. It tests whether the diagnosed control repairs recover deterministic held routing and typed-plan validity; it is not a preregistered v1 result, an executable task result, or a full-Hermes efficacy comparison.
